name: Alibaba Token Plan
notes: Alibaba Model Studio's subscription (Personal and Team Edition), Singapore only. Where the editions differ in price, the Pricing Windows follow Personal Edition. It bills Credits from a monthly quota and has no per-token prices; each model carries the list prices of its pay-as-you-go equivalent (Singapore where Alibaba sells it there), so Cost is what a request would cost there. Takes a Token Plan API key (sk-sp-...), which is not interchangeable with a Model Studio pay-as-you-go key (sk-...) or a Coding Plan key; Personal and Team keys are separate too. The Team overview says Team Edition has its own base URL shown in My Subscriptions; an operator whose console shows another host edits the base URL. Only chat models are shipped: the plan lists image, video and speech models, but the FAQ says they "cannot be called directly through the text model Base URL" and no media endpoint is documented. Left out: auto (picks an underlying model per request, so it has no prices or limits of its own) and qwen4-max-preview (Token Plan only, retired after 2026-11-25). The docs don't say whether explicit cache takes cache_control markers, so the quirk is off. Quota exhaustion answers 429 insufficient_quota and is not billed pay-as-you-go; there is no usage endpoint, so the Provider has no quota reader. Not flagged for Terms Risk (ADR 0099): the docs publish the plan's base URL for any tool that takes a custom Base URL and API key, though they also limit the plan to interactive use in AI coding and agent tools, name automated scripts, custom application backends and platforms such as Dify and n8n as not permitted, and say violations may lead to subscription suspension or API key revocation. Personal Edition is for one person, so sharing the gateway with other people breaches it.

pricingWindows.name: Alibaba Token Plan Night
pricingWindows.notes: The plan's night discount, 22:00-08:00 UTC+8 every day. The docs give no weekday limit. The discount is on Credits consumption as a whole, so each token price is cut by the same share.

upstreamModels.name: Qwen4 Max
upstreamModels.notes: On Personal and Team Edition. Prices are its Singapore pay-as-you-go prices, with the 5-minute explicit cache as the cache write. The output limit is the non-thinking one; thinking mode allows 262,144.

upstreamModels.name: Qwen3.8 Max
upstreamModels.notes: On Personal and Team Edition. Context size, output limit, capabilities and prices are those of qwen3.8-max on Alibaba Model Studio (International). On Personal Edition the Alibaba Token Plan Night window prices it at 40% of the standard prices: the Chinese overview says "享 4 折" (pay 40%). The English overview says "60% off", and the console's "40% Off Nights" badge is a literal translation of 4折. Team Edition gives it no night discount.
